title: دنيا
overview: Saeed, a successful Egyptian businessman in his thirties, has built a new life in Tunisia. Outwardly confident and charismatic, he is a man used to control — in business, in life, and in his marriage. But his relationship with Donya, his introspective wife who is five years his senior, is quietly falling apart. Seeking a fresh start, the couple escapes to their private mountain chalet, far from the noise of the city. In the stillness of nature, they hope to reconnect, to talk, and perhaps to heal
